class.name: OcgBndRange
class.brief_description: This class describes a range in 1D space restricted by two real values. A range can be void indicating there is no point included in the range.
class.description: ! This class describes a range in 1D space restricted ! by two real values. ! A range can be void indicating there is no point included in the range.

method.name: Common
method.description: Replaces <this> with common-part of <this> and theOther

method.name: Union
method.description: Joins *this and theOther to one interval. Replaces *this to the result. Returns false if the operation cannot be done (e.g. input arguments are empty or separated).

method.name: IsIntersected
method.description: Checks if <this> intersects values like theVal+k*thePeriod, where k is an integer number (k = 0, +/-1, +/-2, ...). Returns: 0 - if <this> does not intersect the theVal+k*thePeriod. 1 - if <this> intersects theVal+k*thePeriod. 2 - if myFirst or/and myLast are equal to theVal+k*thePeriod.

method.name: Add_2
method.description: Extends this range to include both ranges.

method.name: GetMin
method.description: Obtain MIN boundary of <this>. If <this> is VOID the method returns false.

method.name: GetMax
method.description: Obtain MAX boundary of <this>. If <this> is VOID the method returns false.

method.name: GetBounds
method.description: Obtain first and last boundary of <this>. If <this> is VOID the method returns false.

method.name: GetIntermediatePoint
method.description: Obtain theParameter satisfied to the equation (theParameter-MIN)/(MAX-MIN) == theLambda. * theLambda == 0 --> MIN boundary will be returned; * theLambda == 0.5 --> Middle point will be returned; * theLambda == 1 --> MAX boundary will be returned; * theLambda < 0 --> the value less than MIN will be returned; * theLambda > 1 --> the value greater than MAX will be returned. If <this> is VOID the method returns false.

method.name: Delta
method.description: Returns range value (MAX-MIN). Returns negative value for VOID range.

method.name: SetVoid
method.description: Initializes <this> by default parameters. Makes <this> VOID.

method.name: Enlarge
method.description: Extends this to the given value (in both side)

method.name: Shifted
method.description: Returns the copy of <*this> shifted by theVal

method.name: TrimFrom
method.description: Trims the First value in range by the given lower limit. Marks range as Void if the given Lower value is greater than range Max.

method.name: TrimTo
method.description: Trim the Last value in range by the given Upper limit. Marks range as Void if the given Upper value is smaller than range Max.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: equal
method.description: Returns TRUE if theOther is equal to <*this>
